interpretive.rule: Attorneys who regularly collect debts are 'debt collectors' under FDCPA — collection law firms have full FDCPA liability
California Rosenthal Act covers original creditors excluded from federal FDCPA — compound federal/state claim framework for California debt collection
Bona fide error defense does not protect legal interpretation errors — only operational/clerical errors; institutional legal-theory violations are actionable

fdcpa_violation_checklist.initial_contact: Did the first communication include the mini-Miranda disclosure (§1692e(11)): 'This is an attempt to collect a debt and any information obtained will be used for that purpose'?
fdcpa_violation_checklist.validation_notice: Within 5 days of first contact, did the collector send written validation notice with debt amount, creditor name, and 30-day dispute right (§1692g)?
fdcpa_violation_checklist.dispute_procedure: Did Michael send written dispute within 30 days? If yes, did collector cease collection and provide verification before resuming?
fdcpa_violation_checklist.false_representations: Did any communication falsely state: (a) the amount of the debt? (b) that the debt was legally enforceable when it resulted from fraud/identity theft? (c) that the collector was an attorney or law firm without authorization to sue?
fdcpa_violation_checklist.harassment: Were calls made before 8am or after 9pm? Were calls made to Michael's workplace after being told to stop? Were calls repeated to harass?
fdcpa_violation_checklist.after_cease_demand: If Michael sent written cease-communication demand, did collection stop within 5 business days?

operational_notes_for_steward_cases.identity_theft_specific: Continuing to collect a debt known to result from identity theft = §1692e(2)(A) false representation of legal status + §1692f unfair means + potential §1681s-2(b) FCRA furnisher violation if reported to CRA. File FTC identity theft report to freeze the collection chain.
operational_notes_for_steward_cases.sol_note: 1-year SOL runs from date of violation. Each communication is a new violation with its own 1-year clock. Compound with Rosenthal Act (California state court), which has a 1-year SOL as well.
